Name: Hyoukyo's Wallpapers And Floors
Author: Rain093
Description:
This is my first mod that I decided to make because I couldn't find any wallpapers and floors that were available for the newest update of Stardew Valley. In the end, I thought I could share it for you all to use as well! 

(The windows used in the pictures are the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3672]Better Windows Mod[/url] )

[u]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    [/u]

[b][color=#00ffff][size=3]Hyoukyo's wallpapers And Floors
(Original)[/size][/color][/b]

[b]Installation:[/b]

[list=1]
[*] Install the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
[*]Download and unzip the mod file.
[*]Drop the entire folder inside the "\Stardew Valley\ Mods" Folder.
[*] Run the game using SMAPI and enjoy! :)
[/list]
[b]Requirements :
[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
[/list]

[color=#00ffff][size=3][b]Hyoukyo's Wallpapers And Floors
 (CWF)[/b][/size][/color]

[b]Installation:

[/b]1. Download and install the latest version of SMAPI
2. Download and install the latest versions of PyTK & Custom Walls and Floors
3. Download and unzip the mod file
4. Drop the entire folder inside the "\Stardew Valley\ Mods" Folder.
5. Run the game using SMAPI and enjoy! :)

[b]Requirements :
[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PYTK[/url]﻿
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3010]Custom Walls and Floors[/url]﻿
[/list]
